headline: Tail low as overnight NQ retraces; Friday policy cluster keeps Stress high
body: Delayed NQ was 29,646.75 (-0.17%) at 01:59:42 UTC after trading 29,595.25-29,667.25, recovering from the overnight low toward the range high. VIX closed at 14.51 and oil edged lower. This does not establish persistent one-way structure; policy/data risk rises sharply into Friday's U.S. session.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock-hours, Tail ranged from 17% to 24%. WATCH states clustered around Nvidia-led continuation and U.S. session catalysts, while meaningful two-way trade repeatedly pulled Tail back below the blocking threshold. The 06:00 UTC slot had no published assessment.
outlookSummary: Overnight Tail remains low while NQ rotation, low VIX and softer oil indicate mean reversion is intact. Stress rises into Friday's 13:45-14:00 UTC cluster. Future WATCH states require one-way extension, weak pullbacks or delayed second-leg repricing; two-way price discovery would keep Tail below the block threshold. After Friday's Globex close, live NQ path evidence is unavailable.
